answer: A numbered mirror panel hangs at one vertex of a garden trellis; at noon the holder angles it so sunlight strikes a numbered mark on the ground, and the keeper photographs the light spot on the mark with the date; two verifiers return in 24 hours, angle a second panel beside it, and match the spot and panel number; a mirror angled wrong or a duplicate number locks and burns the deposit; 100 fakes need 100 mirrors and 100 trellis trips.
